name: BigID
description: The BigID Connector provides seamless access to your BigID environment. Connect to data sources, customize and run scan workflows, and explore your unified data catalog. Gain full visibility into your data security posture with capabilities across DSPM, access governance, privacy, and labeling. Manage regulatory risk, automate assessments, and detect violations in real time. Take immediate remediation actions - reduce access, delete or clean sensitive data, and enforce controls, ensuring end-to-end data and AI protection in one unified connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BigID to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BigID to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bigid-mcp.bigid.cloud/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BigID MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BigID provides these MCP tools: get_objects, write_objects, list_servers, list_tools, and get_tpa_ids.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BigID?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BigID in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
BigID requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BigID is developed by BigID. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
